description: Native Windows Explorer thumbnail provider for SVG and SVGZ files.

script: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "SVG Thumbnail Extension MSI not found: $msi" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "SVG Thumbnail Extension installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "SVG Thumbnail Extension MSI not found: $msi. Refusing to remove Scoop files while Windows Installer registration may remain." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "SVG Thumbnail Extension uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Nonportable system integration: installs the Windows Explorer thumbnail provider for SVG and SVGZ files.
Requires an elevated PowerShell session to install, update, or uninstall.
Disable other SVG thumbnail extensions that may conflict, such as the one included with PowerToys.
